periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonal orientation approximately 45 degrees downward relative to the snout-ear axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval shape with the longitudinal axis approximately twice the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Gradual tapering at the inferior-anterior margin toward the muzzle.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Broad U-shape with a relatively straight posterior border across the upper spinal region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High lateral thickness, spanning approximately 40% of the visible dorsal-ventral torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide gap across the white cranial vertex, measuring roughly 1.5 times the width of a single ear base.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smoothly convex and rounded at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-pink tinting present across the dorsal and cranial white fur regions.
